variants.name: Python
variants.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json

from clyops import Cli

cli = Cli(name="plan")
cli.set_description("Build a deployment plan. Change nothing.")
cli.opt("SERVICE", "service", "s", "api", "Service", rule="choice:api,worker")
cli.opt("ENV", "env", "e", "staging", "Environment", rule="choice:staging,production")
cli.opt("REPLICAS", "replicas", "r", "2", "Replica count", rule="int:1-10")
cli.set_effects("read-only")
cli.set_stdout("Deployment plan", "application/json")
args = cli.run()
print(json.dumps({"service": args.SERVICE, "env": args.ENV, "replicas": args.REPLICAS}))

variants.name: Bash
variants.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
source "${CLYOPS_LIBRARY:-./clyops.sh}"

clyops_name plan
clyops_description "Build a deployment plan. Change nothing."
clyops_opt SERVICE service s api "Service" Options choice:api,worker
clyops_opt ENV env e staging "Environment" Options choice:staging,production
clyops_opt REPLICAS replicas r 2 "Replica count" Options int:1-10
clyops_effects read-only
clyops_stdout "Deployment plan" application/json
clyops_run "$@"
printf '{"service":"%s","env":"%s","replicas":%s}\n' "$SERVICE" "$ENV" "$REPLICAS"
